registry_binding.qualification: Measured NMR signal columns paired with independently computed trapezoidal component-window integrals. Targets are explicitly DERIVED analytical estimates from the same spectra, not independent concentration ground truth. Negative component integrals clipped only for derived area fractions; signed integrals preserved. NaNs are excluded within each integration window, never filled as measured zeros. Future-extracted component templates are forbidden inputs. SourcePMG284 contains999 native snapshots versus1000 nativeMnova rows, and noMnova labels are used. Three underlying measured trajectories; no random-snapshot independence claim. Numerical integration is the primary deterministic baseline; this task view is a reproducible analytical-processing contract, not evidence of a difficult concentration-estimation benchmark.
registry_binding.reference_evidence: CC-BY4.0 Zenodo14814657 native cropped spectral matrices. Factual component/window calibration specifications are documented in official author config.json;5-second hydrosilylation sampling in src/utils.py and measured sucrose timestamps in the CC-BYtime-axis asset. Independently implemented numpy.trapezoid integration; no copied reference estimates or unpublished calibration.
